[[File:Life_Day_tree.png|thumb|right|200px|A decorated Life Day tree]]
A '''Life Day tree''' was a decorated [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] traditionally associated with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] celebration of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. Because wroshyrs reached [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in height in their adult [[Standard year/Legends|years]], younger specimens were chosen as Life Day trees so they could be kept inside a house. They were typically festooned with tinsel and [[Color/Legends|red]] baubles.

A [[Life Day Holo-Tree|holographic version of the tree]] was sold in markets for Life Day.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', December 2012 Life Day celebration</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Life Day tree is a Wookiee equivalent of the real-life [[Wikipedia:Christmas tree|Christmas tree]].
